Introduction

Xinlong is the lead rapper, vocalist, and main dancer of the Chinese boy group BOY STORY under Tencent Music Entertainment and JYPE China. He is also a member of the project group ALPHA DRIVE ONE.

In 2025, he was revealed as a contestant on the survival show Boys II Planet. During the show's finale, he ranked 3rd, securing his spot in the debut group.
